title: Table QR ordering:
items: Number it to the table, so every order knows where it goes.
Put the full menu behind it.
Every dish, with a photo and a veg / non-veg mark.
Mark the dish off before a guest orders it, not after.
Keep the QR where the guest sits.
At eye level on the table, not at the counter.
Put the top 3 dishes first on the menu.
footer: Guests browse and order from the table QR in Sutrixa Rizstay.
